title: Days, weeks and months
examples: How many days are in a week?
How many months are in a year?

explain.say: Today we learn about days, weeks, and months.
There are seven days in one full week.
We have twelve months in one whole year.
A year is made up of many months passing by.
A week is a group of seven days passing by.
In real life, we count days to know when to play.

faq.q: How many days are in a week?
faq.a: There are exactly seven days in one week. These days are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.
asks: Can you list the days of the week?
How many days are in seven days?

faq.q: How many months are in a year?
faq.a: There are twelve months that make up one whole year. They start with January and end with December.
asks: What is the order of the months?
How many months make one year?

faq.q: Is the number of days always the same?
faq.a: The number of days in a week is always seven. The months have different numbers of days sometimes.
asks: Do all weeks have the same number of days?
Does every month have the same number of days?

faq.q: What is the difference between a week and a month?
faq.a: A week is a set group of seven days. A month is a longer time that is made up of several weeks.
asks: Is a week shorter or longer than a month?
What is the difference between a week and a month?

faq.q: What is the longest period we learned about?
faq.a: The longest period we learned about is the year, which contains twelve months.
asks: What is the biggest time period?
How many months are in a whole year?

facts: A week always has seven days.
The months follow a specific order from January to December.
The days of the week repeat every week.

quiz.say: If today is Tuesday, what day will it be in five days?
quiz.why: Counting forward from Tuesday: Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday. That is five days.

wrong.0: This is wrong because you moved back one day instead of forward.
wrong.1: This is wrong because you did not count any days forward at all.
wrong.2: This is wrong because you only counted one day forward.

quiz.say: What is the correct order for the first three months of the year?
quiz.why: The months always follow a set order, and January always comes first.

wrong.0: This is wrong because February always comes right after January.
wrong.2: This is wrong because January always starts the year.
wrong.3: This is wrong because the months must follow the natural calendar order.

quiz.say: How many days are in a full week?
quiz.why: A week is defined as having seven days, which is a standard measurement of time.

wrong.0: This is wrong because five days is only up to Friday, not the whole week.
wrong.1: This is wrong because twelve is the number of months, not days.
wrong.2: This is wrong because the week ends on Sunday, which is the seventh day.
